ResearchProjectDef.label: Healing Solutions: The basics
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn the basics of synthesizing HPserum, a substance designed for combat filled with specialized mechanites that repair wounds in seconds, discover how to craft a raw version that can be applied via different injection methods.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Healing Solutions: Standard protocols
ResearchProjectDef.description: Study a public paper provided by L.I.G.H.T. that describes standard methods and materials for synthesizing and refining HPserum for a greater effect, unlocks standard HPserum recipes.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Healing Solutions: The Experimental Thesis
ResearchProjectDef.description: Your colony found an encrypted file on a lost glitterworld network signal, containing the full thesis of the original creator of HPserum, she describes untested methods and hypotheses that allow to unlock the full potential of HPserum. Study this thesis to learn how to craft an experimental compound capable of healing wounds at an increased factor

ResearchProjectDef.label: Chinis-Series Dartguns
ResearchProjectDef.description: Craft chinis weapons, designed for shooting darts filled with substances

ResearchProjectDef.label: Laotar-Series Rays
ResearchProjectDef.description: Craft laotar weapons, a specialized design that vaporizes the inside substance and condenses it into continuous beams
